credits.title: The Offer
credits.overview: Oswaldo, an ordinary man having an ordinary morning... until he tries to order a coffee. That confronts him with the most uncomfortable question of his life: do I accept a coffee based on a misunderstanding, or is this my moment to come out of the closet?

credits.title: Canciones para el fin del mundo
credits.overview: Luca, a lonely young man, has lost touch with his surroundings and with who he once was. Amid drinks, music, and dancing, he will come face to face with Daniel, with whom he will feel an instant connection. Through their conversations, he will revisit his memories while battling his own mind.
